items.headline: Zuckerberg distances Meta from calls for a coordinated approach on an AI slowdown
items.summary: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg pushed back on a proposal for coordinated slowing of advanced AI development, creating a differentiated signal on AI-capex and development pacing among major technology companies.

items.headline: Brad Gerstner Says Latest ‘Negativity’ Around AI is ‘Political Agenda’; See His 2 New AI Stock Picks
items.summary: Gerstner argued that some AI concerns were exaggerated and discussed AI stock opportunities; the report said Qualcomm would need to show real AI sales to gain investor credit against Nvidia and hyperscaler-built chips.
